hint_html:
Use the palette, sliders, and optional pattern image on the left; JSON for data/chat_ui_theme.json on the right. Saving clears the theme cache and refreshes open chat windows.

Each block uses extra_qss. Layout-affecting properties (e.g. width/height/font-size) are stripped; see theme_chrome.sanitize_chrome_declarations.
invalid_json_not_object: Root must be a JSON object {}.
save_ok_body: Wrote the file and refreshed chat chrome (if a chat window is open).
example_missing_body: Missing {path}. You can Save to write a minimal {} first.
slider_pattern_opacity: Pattern opacity: {percent}% (100% = original; lower values use cached PNG under data/chat_ui_theme_assets/.pattern_cache)
preview_note: When on, the chat window reads data/.chat_ui_theme_preview.json (your on-disk theme file is untouched). Use Generate JSON, then Save, when happy. Closing this page ends preview.
